Environment note: psycopg2-binary failed to build from source in this sandbox (missing libpq-fe.h); installed/tested without it since SQLite is this repo's default and Postgres is an opt-in docker-compose profile, not something this sandbox needs to exercise. Digest PDF generation hit two environment issues: fpdf2 pulls in a broken system cryptography package (same rust-binding panic prior runs hit) and a broken system PIL (compiled for a different Python ABI than what is actually running) -- worked around by stubbing cryptography and blocking the PIL import before importing fpdf, consistent with the prior run's workaround.
